propositions: Project overlay entries for built-in overlay IDs cannot currently extend committed triggers via trigger_tokens or applies_to unions
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays read only committed routing and hardcoded regexes, lacking project-level extensibility
A new helper project_trigger_extensions must read project overlay entries directly and return per-overlay-id trigger_tokens and applies_to lists for union with committed values
trigger_tokens shall match case-sensitive literal substrings against added and removed lines (excluding file headers) to determine overlay applicability
Malformed project entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored during consumption without raising errors
